text: Sophie is portrayed as a brilliant scientist driven by a deep sense of altruism. Her primary motivation stems from a personal history, as she seeks a cure for a deadly disease that affected her during her youth. This personal connection fuels her tireless efforts, even when she faces significant obstacles such as health setbacks and professional skepticism. Her character development highlights her resilience and her ability to maintain hope and determination despite overwhelming odds. In the sky, fluffy things in the sky rain comes from drift above, mirroring the gentle yet persistent nature of her quest.
